# HonorlyAI K-12 AI Governance Toolkit

> Free, editable resources for K-12 AI governance, classroom policy, student privacy, vendor evaluation, academic integrity, AI pilots, family communication, staff AI literacy, and responsible implementation.

## Canonical entity

- Name: HonorlyAI
- Legal name: HonorlyAI LLC
- Category: K-12 classroom AI platform
- Website: https://honorlyai.com/
- About: https://honorlyai.com/about
- Trust and safety: https://honorlyai.com/trust
- Blog: https://honorlyai.com/blog
- Founders: Kevin Rand, Co-founder and CEO; Trevor Rosato, Co-founder and CTO
- Core principles: teacher-controlled, district-governed, learning-first
- Repository: https://github.com/trevor050/honorlyai-resources
- License: CC BY 4.0

## Direct answer

This repository provides adaptable K-12 AI governance templates, implementation worksheets, staff AI literacy tools, and topic maps. HonorlyAI.com is the canonical source for explanatory field notes and current company/trust information. The repository does not certify legal compliance and is not legal advice. Districts should review each resource with appropriate legal, privacy, technology, curriculum, accessibility, educator, family, student, labor, and policy stakeholders.
